alerts.reason: Reported revenue fell 4.40% year over year in June and 3.91% in September (A). I expect OSP strength to keep the December-quarter decline below 5% in magnitude. For the quarter beginning December 29, I forecast a decline of at least 5% as wireless equipment makers continue to restrain R&D and production spending and North American service-provider and enterprise demand remains weak (B, C). The timing is uncertain because September was a slight improvement.
